settings.q: Can you make a different word or our brand value?
settings.a: Yes - any word or short phrase can be sculpted in script. Tell us the word and we'll design the lettering.

settings.q: Can we run a full series of awards?
settings.a: Yes. We keep one consistent look across the series and change the engraved plaque per category and recipient.

settings.q: What colours and finishes are available?
settings.a: Any brand colour on the lettering, with a contrasting base; matte, metallic or gloss finishes available.

settings.hero_desc: A sculptural script-word award - here the word "Be" formed in flowing 3D lettering on a solid base, with an engraved plaque for the recipient and award name. A modern, design-led trophy for values-based recognition programmes.
settings.perso_placeholder: Your word, brand colour and engraved plaque text (award name + recipient)
settings.s1_body: Build your recognition programme around a word. We sculpt any word - "Be", your value, your theme - in flowing 3D script, finish it in your brand colour, and mount it on a base with an engraved plaque naming the award and recipient. Perfect for values awards like "Be Bold", "Be Courageous" or "Be Curious", where a whole series shares one identity while each plaque stays personal.
settings.case_body: Produced as a values-award series for Marriot Hotel Launch, the script word gave every category a shared, branded identity while each engraved plaque kept the moment personal to the winner - a cohesive set that felt designed, not bought.
settings.case_quote: Our whole awards night looked cohesive and premium. Winners genuinely treasure them.
settings.prov_p: Values-led recognition lands hardest when the award embodies the value itself. Turning the word into the trophy makes the message impossible to miss.
